name: chat_post_message
description: Sends a message to a channel as the workspace bot; the message ts is generated server-side and threaded replies bump the parent's reply_count (POST /chat.postMessage)

channel.description: Channel, private group, or IM channel to send message to. Can be an encoded ID (C…), or a name (#launch-room).

text.description: The formatted text of the message to be published.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's ts value to make this message a reply. Avoid using a reply's ts value; use its parent instead.

username.description: Set your bot's user name for this message. Defaults to ms-crm-agent.
